name: A lesson learned

date.label: Burning Crusade Shadowmoon quest chain; exact in-world date unknown

summary: Oronok sends the seeker back into flayer territory to destroy their eggs after his boars were attacked. The lesson is practical and severe: the threats around the farm will not leave by themselves. No nest is given an exact position, and no individual flayer is named. When the work is done, the story can leave the farmer’s errands behind. Oronok has decided that the visitor has earned the account he withheld.
